Bug_Title: EI2: May expose internal representation by incorporating reference to mutable object (EI_EXPOSE_REP2)
Bug_Details:
This code stores a reference to an externally mutable object into the
internal representation of the object. 
 If instances
 are accessed by untrusted code, and unchecked changes to
 the mutable object would compromise security or other
 important properties, you will need to do something different.
Storing a copy of the object is better approach in many situations.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the constructor of the BuggyClass where a reference to an externally mutable object (List<String> data) is stored into the internal representation of the object. This could lead to untrusted code modifying the internal state of the object, which might compromise security or other important properties.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered by modifying the external mutable object after it has been passed into the BuggyClass constructor. This modification is then reflected in the internal state of the BuggyClass object, which results in a test failure.
